transcript.content: Hello, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, it's really nice to meet you too, Doctor. Thank you for taking the time to see me. 

Um... well, I guess I'm here because... well, work actually suggested I come in. I hope that's okay? I've just been having a little bit of trouble lately with, um, keeping track of things. Just slipping up on things, really, like... forgetting scheduled callbacks, or missing some work orders. Even just basic follow-ups that I promised people I'd take care of. 

I really do mean to do them, and I want to do a good job, but... they've sort of piled up on me recently. More than I'd like to admit. It got to the point where my supervisor sent me here, just to make sure I get things sorted out before I lose my shot at moving up to a better position. I'm really trying my best to stay on top of it all, I promise. Does that... does that make sense for why I'd be here?
Did you have these kinds of trouble with attention or keeping track of things when you were a child?

Oh, um... well, yes, I suppose so. I hope it doesn't sound like I'm just making excuses, but... I actually remember being this way way back in grade school, long before any of this current job pressure started. 

I always tried really hard to be a good student, and my teachers were always so nice to me. They'd tell my parents I was a bright girl, which was sweet of them to say, but... well, I did tend to misplace my papers a lot. And sometimes I'd just sort of miss parts of the directions they gave out, or I'd need a few extra reminders to actually finish up my classwork. I was never trying to be difficult or ignore them, I promise! I just... lost track of things sometimes, even back then. 

Does that... is that the kind of thing you were asking about?
Do you have this same kind of trouble keeping track of things in other parts of your life besides work?

Oh, um... outside of work? No, not really. At least, I haven't really noticed it being a problem at home. 

I try really, really hard to keep my personal life organized, you know? I mean, I guess maybe I'll misplace my keys or leave a tool out in the garage every now and then, but... well, everyone does that sometimes, right? It's nothing major. At home, I can just take my time and do things my own way, so I don't have that same pressure of all those work orders piling up on me. I really do my best to keep my house tidy and stay on top of my own chores. 

I hope that's okay? Like, does it make sense that I'm mostly just struggling with it at my job right now?
Do you often feel anxious at work?

Anxious? Oh, um... no, I wouldn't say I feel anxious. I mean, I want to do a good job, of course, and I always try my hardest to make sure everyone is happy with my work. 

I guess sometimes I feel a little... flustered? Just when things get really busy and I realize I've missed a call or a work order, because I hate letting people down. But it's not like a panic or anything like that. I really do try to stay positive and just keep working through it. I hope that's the right answer? I just wouldn't want you to think I'm, you know, falling apart or anything. I'm just trying to get a little better at juggling everything.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Depressed? Oh, gosh, no. No, I wouldn't say that at all. 

I mean, everyone has a bad day here and there, right? Especially when I mess up at work and get behind, I might feel a little disappointed in myself because I really want to be doing a good job for everyone. But I'm definitely not depressed. I try to always look on the bright side of things and keep a smile on my face. I'm actually a pretty happy person, overall! 

I just want to get this work stuff sorted out so I can be my usual cheerful self all the time. Does that make sense? I hope you don't think I'm complaining too much about things.
Have these attention or organization problems ever caused significant trouble for you in any setting other than work?

Um, no... no, I really don't think so. Not significant trouble, anyway. Like I was mentioning a little bit ago, I really do try my best to keep everything else in my life running smoothly. 

I mean, sure, maybe I'm a little scatterbrained at home sometimes, or I might forget to text a friend back right away, but I always make sure it doesn't actually hurt anyone or cause real problems. I'd just feel terrible if I let my friends or family down! So I work extra hard to keep all of that under control. 

It really is just my job where it's... well, where it's becoming a bit of a headache for me. I hope it's okay that it's mostly just a work thing? Am I giving you the right kind of information? I just don't want you to think my whole life is a mess, because I promise I'm holding the rest of it together pretty well!
